title: Estrada: cotton joints and cyanoacrylate glue

tellings.quote: They use cyanoacrylate, and it gives it quite an interesting hardness, right?

plain: The three-fingered "alien" bodies shown in Peru were put together with cotton at the joints and cyanoacrylate, the chemical in superglue, which gives them "quite an interesting hardness". A guest named Flavio Estrada tells Michels this from his own examination of the figures, offering it as evidence that they were made by people, not left by any unknown being.
